decisions: Simulated login with name+role picker instead of real MOE authentication, since no backend/auth service is available
Used a shared client-side data store (Summit.save/load) so student feedback is visible to teacher view without a real server
Replaced 'AI summary' requirement with a transparent keyword-frequency summary since no real AI API call is possible in this environment
Used Anime.js for screen transitions and star-rating pop animations for a playful feel
Course dropdown options set to Apple Media, Video Journalism, Figma, and AI course
Suggestion box placeholder text set to 'Type here…e.g, We should have a photography course.'
Textarea placeholder text changes dynamically based on Suggestion/Complaint selection instead of static text
